findings.evidence: `HadronMultiplet.image_conj_inter_valence` (line 150): `(Species.flavorPair i ∩ C.valence h).image Species.conj = Species.flavorPair i ∩ C.valence (C.conj h)`; `IsValenceFlavor.image_conj_inter_valence` (line 104): `(Species.flavorPair i ∩ valence h).image Species.conj = Species.flavorPair i \ valence h`. Instantiating the second at `valence := C.valence` and chaining the first backwards gives the stated goal verbatim.
findings.fix: Delete it (and then `IsValenceFlavor.antiquark_mem_iff`/`quark_mem_iff` at lines 92 and 98, whose only use is this proof), or replace the proof body with `(C.image_conj_inter_valence h i).symm.trans hi.image_conj_inter_valence`.
findings.issue: `IsValenceFlavor.inter_valence_conj_eq_sdiff` re-proves by `ext`/`simp`/`rcases` exactly the composite of two lemmas sitting above it in the same file, and nothing in the repo uses it (grep for `inter_valence_conj_eq_sdiff` in `EpsilonEridani/` hits only this declaration and its mention in the module docstring at line 48).

findings.evidence: `EpsilonEridani/Particles/Fragmentation/Basic.lean:103-106` declares `@[simp] lemma indicatorUnitInterval_of_notMem ... : indicatorUnitInterval f h i z Q2 = 0`. Grep for `valenceStepFrag_eq_zero` in `EpsilonEridani/` returns only lines 363-368 (the declaration); by contrast `valenceStepFrag_apply_of_mem`/`_of_notMem` are used at lines 401-410 and do resolve the `if`, so they earn their place.
findings.fix: Delete it; a caller needing the value off the unit interval uses `valenceStepFrag_def` together with `indicatorUnitInterval_of_notMem`, as this proof itself does.
findings.issue: `valenceStepFrag_eq_zero` is a `@[simp]` restatement of `Fragmentation.indicatorUnitInterval_of_notMem` for this one family — its proof is `rw [valenceStepFrag_def, indicatorUnitInterval_of_notMem _ hz]` and nothing else — and it has no consumer, so it only adds a second simp route to the same fact.

summary: The two prior findings are fixed and the new material is genuinely new (no Mathlib/Physlib/TauCeti/EpsilonEridani counterpart for Species.map, flavorPair, ValenceContent or the favoured/unfavoured split; the two-index Fragmentation.comap is not covered by the single-index PDF.comap). Two declarations in the diff still re-derive what neighbouring lemmas already provide and have no consumer.
